decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall keep the thinning of the epicormic growth to a minimum and shall leave at least 2 - 3 (preferably 3) epicormic shoots per old pruning cut. The remaining epicormic shoots shall be of at least 30cm length and shall contain buds/leaves sufficient to provide an even cover of leaf bearing structure throughout the crown. The works shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved trees.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
